commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Amad Diallo (Ivory Coast) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

90+8' Good work from Ivory Coast as they win a corner. Oumar Diakite (Ivory Coast) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90+7' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ivory Coast.

90+7' Orjan Nyland reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Amad Diallo (Ivory Coast) towards the top left corner. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ivory Coast will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+5' Martin Odegaard (Norway) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Valenzuela no option but to blow his whistle. Ivory Coast are awarded a free kick.
90+3' Emerse Fae has decided to substitute Ghislain Konan and he is replaced by Bazoumana Toure (Ivory Coast).
